name: Candy Village
description:
Residents: Numerous Candies

Candy Village is home to residents all resembling candy of some sort. These residents each has different purposes and act as a whole whenever the famous Candy Lane Racers Tournament is taking place. The village is very large and sits on its own island. The Candyflop Airport is the largest in the region and attracts millions of tourist each year. It is believe that once gods incorporated Candy Village and left behind its many mysterious wonders.

name: Candyflop Airport
description: Candyflop Airport is the busiest airport in the region. It is second only to Food Town in the entire world. Candyflop Airport sits on a high mountain located west of the Candy Village area. It possesses numerous flights including the most famous and luxurious, the SS Wonka.

name: North Candy Village
description:
Residents: Proud & Wealthy People

North Candy Village is home to the proud and wealthiest of Candy Village residents. It is located south of the rocky mountains that once was believe to be the home of the gods.

name: South Candy Village
description:
Residents: Workers Of Candy Village

Home to the numerous workers of Candy Village. This place has giant lollipops decorating its main streets serving as lights. The many festivals of the village is performed here.

name: East Candy Village
description:
Residents: Various

Home to the various people of Candy Village that prefers quiet and peace as this portion of the village is far away and separated by a long hard honey bridge

name: Downtown Candy Village
description:
Residents: None

Located at the center of the village. It is a big beautiful place made up of glass and sugar sweets. The entire place has wifi and holds many of the town’s biggest companies.

name: Chocolate Factory
description:
Residents: None

The busiest and most famous place of Candy Village. All the residents of Candy Village are made here. Although this is never openly mentioned. Chocolate Factory holds a great place in it’s residents hearts. It was once believe before the village took it over with the help of Peppermint King. That the factory was once home of the gods.

name: Peppermint Valley
description:
Residents: Peppermint King

A deep valley surrounded by a river made up of caramel. It surrounds the Chocolate Factory and is home to the Peppermint King.

name: Dark Licorice Forest
description:
Residents: Sourpatch King & Numerous Dark Creatures

A dark gloomy forest that is lit up by various bitter tasting candies. It is home to the Sourpatch King and his many servants. It is barred off by giant hard candies and the Sugar Post.

name: Milk Sea
description: A massive size place that sits around Candy Village. It separates mostly every known island in the world.

name: Goldenflake Beach
description: A massive beach that sits on the East and South side of Candy Village. It smells like the Goldenflakes cereal and when the milky waves hit it. It sparkles.

name: Sugar Post
description:
Residents: Candy Hill Highguard

A post that is home to the group of security of Candy Village. It is home to the CANDY HILL HIGHGuard. It is located in front of the Dark Licorice Forest.

The CANDY HILL HIGHGuard is a place where all of the security of Candy Village is based. It is also home to the largest prison in the village.

name: Butterscotch Hill
description:
Residents: Gramcracker Citizens

A steep hill made up of butterscotch candy, at its center is a giant factory known as the Chocolate Factory. It is home to the Gramcracker Citizens and is surrounded by high gates made up of smores.

name: Candycane Lake
description: An enchanted lake surrounded by giant candy canes and huge floating crystal apples. It’s a popular hangout spot for tourists and residents of Candy Village. It believe that the waters of this lake presents healing and creation properties.

name: Candy Lane Tournament
description: A mass event which holds over 17 different race courses. Each with different designs and features. After each race, the winner wins a magical medallion and after each tournament the winner takes home a prize award. The courses are located across Candy Village however all are named after the Candy Lane.

name: Candy Kane Forest
description: A candy enhanced forest made up of candy cane trees, giant gingerbread made mountains, a waterfall made up of juice, and several other fruity scenery.

name: Big Red Estate
description:
Residents: The Big Red Family

Home to the Big Red Family. It is still used today after 400 years of existence by the family.

*The estate is large enough to incorporate a race track which is used by the Candy Lane Racers. It can only be unlocked once Big Red wins the other 17 courses. He is the only one who can unlock this race.

name: Candyhill High
description:
A popular high school found in Candy Village. It populates almost all of Candy Village children at one point.

*A short race track can be found in the school which covers across the sports fields with the school in the background. A snippet of this course is seen during the first race in the tournament. The full course is unlocked once the students win the Candyville Middle School course.

name: Candyville Middle School
description:
A popular middle school and one of the main places for Giggly Gumdrop when she isn’t racing.

*The school is home to one hidden race track which directs itself right through the main school classes. It can be unlocked only if the riders win the normal 17 courses.

name: Candydrop College
description:
Residents: Candydrop Students (If They Live On Campus)

A distant college with over six main buildings. It is the place where many of the Candyhill High students attend after they graduate.

*It has a hidden race course which directs across numerous buildings. It can only be unlocked when the riders win the normal 17 courses.

name: Candystone Shortcake
description:
Residents: Stevie Shortcake & Princess Candyshack

A popular city with shortcake decorating much of the town’s image. It is seen as a multihued of pink with Princess Candyshack as its leader. It separates Candy Village and Le’Drinkaton.

*Also serving as one of the famous races. This place can only be unlocked during the tournament if won by Princess Candyshack or Stevie Shortcake.

name: Giggly Gumdrop’S Home
description:
Residents: Giggly Gumdrop

Home to Giggly Gumdrop, her parents are never seen. However pictures of them are seen in the background on a desk. If only slightly. It is covered in numerous candies like Giggly herself.

*Only can be unlocked in the tournament when Giggly wins the other 17 courses.

name: Baker Estate
description:
Residents: Cindy Cutterhill

Home to Cindy Cutterhill. It is a mid-sized estate that has the scent of cookies and other delights. In its rear is a hidden factory.

*The factory portion of this home can be unlocked only if Cindy Cutterhill wins all 17 courses.

name: Candy Rain Tv Station
description: This news station is home to the famous Candy Rain TV News. It is located in the center of Downtown Candy Village and serves as the tallest tower in Candy Village. From the tip of it, someone could see the lights of Food town.

name: Snowball Berry
description: A bowling arena for the city of Candy Village. Most of the city’s citizens come to this bowling alley as a pastime.

name: Marshmallow Post
description:
Residents: Marshmallow People, Vanilla People, Chocolate People, Ms. Choco Chocolate, Smore Kids, & Marshmallow Man

A giant mountain range found circling Candy Village. It is home to the Marshmallow, Vanilla, and Chocolate People. Marshmallow man is its prime resident.

name: Golden Stone Bridge
location: Between Food Town, Candy Village, And Crystal Star Kingdom
description: A large bridge made of hard honey. It is often sticky unless driven on. It is large and separates into three directions at its center. One side leads to Food Town, Candystone Shortcake, and Crystal Star Kingdom.

name: Lium
description:
Also known as: Liumus
Race: Elitshian Gods

Built high above the mortals, this place has hundreds of castles serving as homes to the many gods. In its center is the tower where the most importantly Royal Circa deities meets and command the world. On each four corner of this floating island lie doorways to many places such as the Underworld, Heaven, Earth, and Norgard. Never to receive storms or any kind of diTantirithter this place was protected by the eyebrows of Yonrohs and his blood became the Milky Way and Lium's rivers. It has approximately 50 islands all of which serve many different purposes such as one is the place where the School of Angels is located and can be reaching through magic. Access to this place by others besides immortals, is through Mt. Punukien which was the highest point in Elitshia.

name: Oacklands
description:
Race: Elitshian Gods

Lying somewhere in the northeast region of Lium, this place would have waters flowing down to earth, down to Onur, and then turns to fire as it reaches Hell or Belckus. The River of Insanity accompanies by a spirit of the same name was cast of flames and ran from north and west of the Oacklands. Once a beautiful region it would be discarded as evil took control of it.

name: Pond of Innocence
description:
Race: Domaedians, Jessana, & Authoria (temporary residents)

More of a relative term for a substance of water that has been blessed by a priest or holy power. The actual pond is located in Heaven. Surrounded by beauty, it remains untouched by all things. Baffling the gods, this beautiful place was mistakenly discovered by Jessana and Authora after building the Spring of Truth in the underworld as its waters ran into the spring. Kept a secret to preserve its mystery, this place is where angels drink from and blesses it as well.

name: Magic Gates
description: Powerful gates that can transports its users almost anywhere that has it’s own gate. The gates were made by ancient mages to travel to other worlds. One was made by the Elitshians using magic they learned from Bewithia when she taught them basic magic. Currently there are over 1,000 gates across 999 worlds. One is in an unknown location that was hidden for strategic purposes.

name: Tenir
description:
Race: spirits of the unborn

A bridge that connects life that comes down from the heavens or Norgard to the living. Spirits are carried across in various forms depicting the stages of that person’s life. They would appear blindfolded and if someone would remove their blindfolds before entering the world of the living they would be blind in the living. Over the course of time many immortals and angels stood watch over this place.

name: Arkylente
description: A valley created by the gods to house their most sacred food the Golden Honey. The Golden honey could make its drinker immortal as well as the Golden Apples could give great knowledge. A thick illusion of fog and mist protects it from sight, and a wall of black marble rocks erects to protect the sacred lands. A masking veil, Venyur was created by magicians to hide it from those wish it harm. Overtime the veil failed and tourists of all legions would overthrow it. The honey is presented by the Arkylentese' ancient spirits, children to Yonrohs would present the honey every hour to the gods as they lounged and partied. Also found in this valley were the Arch Berries which could give great supernatural abilities, the Magna Trees' bark could make the body invincible. The Dargen Apples were also very sacred as they could grant great speed as well as the Mosten Seeds if planted could raise five trees that could grant up to three wishes per person. Genies are said to come from this tree along with imps who also protects it.

name: Mountains of Caldone
description:
Race: Jonun, Groners, Caldonians, Ho’zares

A place existing as one of the untouched regions by time. It was the hideaway home for Jonun whenever the deity wanted to disappear from all. Here his children the Groners and himself lived in peace deciding the fates of all living beings. This region was misty and had mountains as tall as the tallest ones here on Earth. It had many torn down cities once told to harbor life. Its people was once the Caldonians the first human race but after they were driven from Earth by the gods they founded this place where they ascended to become the Ho'zares of legend. In return the gods made this their home, but the Ho'zares retaliated destroying them and their new destination. The Ho'zares reverted time and became supreme rulers, they then created Anka, from him Elshack, and from him the Gods.

name: Outer Realm
description:
Race: Magical beings

The Outer Realm is a place of glorious magic. Built by Olerta and Bewithia during the rise of the supernatural phenomenons on Earth to insure a place where all magical and mystical characters can live and roam without interruptions. It is a place that differs in scenary because of the tribe of beings that live there. Over a thousand places have been said to have existed in the Outer Realm and some appeared through this book. Of such was the Black Forest which stood on Earth but its gates were located far south in the Ice Realm. There were also well known realms of the six natural elements. The Fire, Ice, Water, Spirit, Light, and Dark Realm “dark worlds” were all located just on the boundaries of the East, South, North, and West parts of the Outer Realms. Dragons were keepers of many castles and dungeons that lied in Outer Realm. The Mountains of Caldone also existed just north of the Outer Realm. On its East and West sides lied the Earth and the Underworld. Overlooking this magical place were several griffins who took watch since its birth. Gates to this place was protected by demons, angels, and Sholls “Elitshian trolls” and all were neutral in deciding who entered. Once humans traveled to this place by mistake after finding one gate unguarded and from their trip, they wrote stories which some could say made way for current fables and folklore.

name: Xisitira
description:
Race: Xeserians

Considered a mysterious area of the world because takes about 40 years to get to this place from any direction. Living here were the Xeserians, mystical beings who watched over good and evil. From them came the Book of Sanctuary later given to the tribes of Elite Force.

name: Dark Realm
description:
Race: evil beings

One of the 14 realms. One of the many realms associated with the Outer Realm. Not much is known about the appearance of this place, but some expect its appearance to be like Hell or at least a fragment of it. Seen from a distance to be surrounded by the Stream of Regret and a force field called the veil of darkness in which someone considered “good” couldn't pass through.

name: Teir
location: through all mirrors or reflective surfaces
description:
Race: opposite of anything with a reflection in the original Earth

A place like Earth where anything that reflects an image life. Here the opposite of what goes on, on Earth happens. The only physical difference in appearance to Teir is that things appear mostly night here. Those that are good here are bad in our world and vice versa. Things that are dead here are alive in our world and vice versa. Instead of one year here it takes about 6 months for one year to pass. Rather which world would be consider the real original home and which other is a reflection is an interesting debate. Both Teir and Earth were created at the same time by mistake after one of the others “goes unstated which” didn't come out as planned.

name: Onur
location: Above Hell, below the rest of the Universe
description:
Also known as: Underworld
Race: the dead

Home of the Old Worlders, it is a city in the year 5001 and one of the only cities left in the world. It is located where the current Paris, France is, and it borders Alkanae’ home to the New Worlders. It is one of the main cities in the story Afterworld.

name: Tel
description:
Race: spirits ready to be reincarnated

A bright domain located farthest west of Lium. Here souls of the most beloved lives in peace, however souls are sent here in hopes of reincarnation to rejoin their love ones. In this place the souls go on various tasks to try and get their lives back.  Those who died a wrongful death come here. This place is guided and guarded by ancient spirits.

name: Often Springs
location: Located at the center of the world
description:
Race: Home of the Sun & Moon gods

Located near the center of the planet. Hidden from sight, the Often Springs is where Ohn, Sun God and his sister Seltice, the moon goddess, takes the sun and moon every day and night. Here lies an ocean where the sun is put to rest and from the steam here lies the night air and cool breeze. Also from this comes mist and fog. The moon is hidden in the mountains where its rays can be seen from Earth as the Aurora Borelias. When the rays are not seen on Earth it’s because the moon is asleep a time which is most often.

name: Olvulga
location: Located in the year 5001 in current New York City
description:
Race: Vulgists

A large city of a wide range of technology such as teleportation machines replacing public transportation. It was the first city in the world to replace modern transportation with teleportation technology.

name: Orcross
description:
Race: the dead

This place exists somewhere before the dead gets to Eternity, it lies anywhere near Oblivion, Onur, Heaven, far from Hell, and close to the lands of the living. It is a foggy place with walls erected high in the distance showing cities of mysterious origins and residency. Orcross wasn’t created yet it appeared after Eternity was formed by Olerta. How it appeared is still a mystery to the gods including Olerta who created most places in the afterlife including the thought of Hell during the fall of Santaniel. This place is a holding place for all souls that are waiting for their judgement into Heaven or Hell. Although many only remain here for mere seconds it can feel like a hundred years if the person is aware of their existence here. Most however are lucky enough to not be aware and leaves only moments of appearing. Teleportation often come here by mistake when the teleporter is inexperience because of its direct connection to the land of the living. Most psychics can reach this place mentally contacting the dead if the dead barely died.

name: Helliholm
description:
Race: Anka

The highest place of existence. Nothing exists above or around it. It houses Anka in his ever-growing domain. Here all things were created and where all things end. Anka being the primordial force that created GOD and one day will take back his creation to create another GOD at the end of all things. It is said that Anka himself created this place to make sure nothing can find him nor see him although Azazel through unknown means was able to come here. With many believing that either Azazel was once a GOD or possibly the child of Anka or to become the new GOD. The chamber which Anka resides is known as Kendole.

name: The Frefrenick
location: Located at the center of the Eternity
description: A hallway which opens into a circle room, in this room lays the gates to Heaven, Hell, Onur, Lium, Norgard, Oblivion, and Earth. Voices direct and try to trick anyone that enters this place. Entering the wrong door could trap someone forever in eternal damnation.

name: Oblivion
description:
Race: Deceased immortal beings & deceased beings from Heaven & Hell

A place a vast as the underworld, it is covered in mist and takes its image from the darkness that exists in it. Dead trees, restless souls, and no way out. Oblivion is a place where no one could return. Believed to have been created or at least founded by Olerta, this place has to way in unless someone is banished here by a powerful force. It is a massive place found within Eternity serving as its underworld for immortals who became deceased.

name: The River Watch
description: A river that runs quietly throughout south Oblivion. Here the souls of Oblivion eat and drinks, the food that is found near this river and the water that comes from it both erases the memory and history of those that drink and eat them.

name: Island of the Seefors
description:
Race: Seefors

Found somewhere far in the Pacific Ocean, this small island, is similar in look to both Ancient Greece and Elitshia with its towers and Pathenon like structures. It is home to the Queen of the Seefors and the thousands of siren like creatures. It has since been destroyed and its past can be reached through a spell where the city now only exists. The island is protected by a giant clam like shield with a globe like structure erected around it to protect its residences.

name: Mirror World
description:
Also known as: Ashkaloom
Race: Everything’s opposites

The exact opposite of the normal world, Ashkaloom shows its difference normally because it has two suns and three moons. The world and universe is one of billions that exist in the Eliteverse and is often the home of the evil and jokster beasts the Mirror Giest.

name: Prison X
description:
Race: Prisons from around the Universe

A prison located in the Onegalus, it is of massive size and is magically enhanced with advance technology and was created by a group of Descendants, human scientists, Domaedians, and some Belki as an ultimate prison to trap the universe’s most dominate prisoners. Often when imprisoned here, the prisoner undergoes many tasks such as purification, memory wiping, and various tasks to turn their behaviors. The prison grows larger with the welcoming of more prisoners. At the center hall, are doorways to various places including Oblivion for the worse of the worse criminals and portals to different worlds, however only passwords and/or keycards can open these portals.

name: Onegalus
description: A parallel universe with no inhabitants, its gravitational pull is the reason behind its lack of residency. It is located somewhere on the other side of time from our own universe and it is located far from simple traveling reaches. It contains air that is breathable and dark cloud like substances that if touch can be lethal to any known race. Many prisoners are trapped here in Prison X located somewhere in the northern portion of this universe. Onegalus has a negative effect on all outsiders and can only be reached through portals found through warp streams across the universe.

name: Mountains of Indomnia
description:
Race: Indomnians (before the city of Indomnia was destroyed)

A vast mountain range found on the eastern border of Elitsyia. The tip of the mountains appeared as golden dust while the base was white. At its center used to be Indomnia which turned into ruins. The range existed long after the city. Some believed that the mountains once were the gates to the afterlife and that the people that once lived there were the dead brought back to life to live in the city.

name: Indomnia
location: Center of the mountains of Indomnia
description:
Race: Indomnians

In ancient times it was believed that while on Earth the god Montum created a beautiful place he could call his own personal paradise. The place was depicted as a massive land surrounded by giant walls. Statues sit at the corners of the city with large trees lining up the main road into the city. The homes and buildings were made of rock and glass like stone. The people were some of the world’s first prophets known as Indomnians or simply Domnia. Over time the city was populated by individuals whom most of the world thought was dead. The place had an effect and from its soil came magical pearl like structures that brought the dead back to life without any of its circumstances and effects. The pearls were destroyed when the city was raided and destroyed. All that was left was decayed buildings and mountains. The Domnia remained while a few of the inhabitants returned to the afterlife.

name: River of Torment
description: Found in the underworld, this region filled with conflicted souls of the deceased was near the edge of the underworld. Here the Springs of Eternal Damnation flowed into. All of mankind's dark emotions would flow into this ocean and so would the rivers of the underworld.

name: River of Onur
description: There were literally hundreds of rivers found in the underworld. All were guarded and token care of by spirits. Most of their names were just derived from the many human emotions that we suffers in life. Most leaks onto the world and from them we bathe or drink from giving us such emotions and others are in secret found only in the underworld. The River of Pain and Grief were two of the most popular ones with the River of Suicide Victims and the River of Anger were others. Each sin had their own river along with zodiacs of western mythology. Sorrow, Sadness, Depression, Disease, Doubt, Suffering, Murder, Hate, Force, Adultery, War, Famine, Death, and Strife all were rivers as well. Each river connected at some point into the Ocean of Torment. Some of the lighter emotions like the River of Tears and the River of Desire flowed into the banks of the Spring of Truth. The Spring of Truth was a big spring that flowed from the Heavens, its waters could get anyone to tell the truth and with it the gods and spirits used it to bless objects such as steel and used them against forces like demons. From the Spring of Truth is considered holy water as it can repel evil spirits and demonic entities. Khani was thrown into this spring to save the world. From his rotting corpse and his blood became the new fears of the new world this time without the influence of the gods. At one point in history the many fears and emotions of the world were sealed away in a box which was in return hidden into the Ocean of Torment for safe keeping. But one day someone found it and opened it and flowed free the emotions and fears into the rivers of the world.

name: Spring of Damnatian
description:
Some stories believe that this spring could grant those to enters its waters with the power to speak to the dead and to come back from death. The fountain appears silver with water that flows gently to the dead and loudly to the undead. If drunken the water could instantly kill or appear as acid. The spring was once a present of the gods to one of the most beloved queens who have died and once lived in the underworld where the spring now sits.

Another myth surrounds the spring that it can provide the drinker or anyone who touches its waters eternal pain and suffering. Which is one of the reasons why the spring has been hunted by both the dead and the living for centuries.

name: Time Gate
description:
Race: Shecknurd, Kain, Spirits of Time, & Cosmic Soldier of the Milky Way

During the only part of the Universe where time stands still, exist a place of complete silence where The Cosmic Soldier of the Milky Way, several Spirits of Time, and sometimes Shecknurd & Kain watches over all time. This place is considered a floating island with five giant gates. Each gate represents something in time, Past, Present, Future, Alternative Timeline, & Moments that should have happened but didn’t. Severael powerful Belki tried to come through these gates so that they could reinvent the past. They however were stopped by Kain while unleashing the ultimate power of his time abilities.

name: The Sky Realm
description:
Race: Adv & Sky Deities

Home to all sky deities, this place was so beautiful that it was on constant watch by its creator, Adv. One of its most important halls was the Watch Room where the world is on constant watch by the Sky deities. Another famous hall is where Ohn and Night both takes the sun and moon into and from here, they take them from for their journeys across the skies. The Hall of the East and North winds is found on the East side of the Castle. The Hall of the West and South winds are located toward the West side of the castle. Another important room would have to be the Sky Room where the Elitshians believed that the sky rested and was being held up by the many avatars of Khani for punishment of trying to overthrow the gods. Both Adv and her children all can be seen drawn on walls holding up this castle above the Earth's skies.

name: Andvom
description:
Race: Shecknurd & Spirits of Time

Seen from the distance as a group of stars circling a long hall with no end. Andvom is a wide place with one center room. In this room the giant book of all things is placed and in it lays the records of all actions taken by all things. There are about 5 halls which connect to this giant room. One hall the spirits of time roams and here they each watch over a moment in history, also their purposes are protecting everyone, inanimate object, dead and living things, and immortals. Two halls exist on the South and North halls, in the South halls the past is recorded and in the North halls the future is recorded. In the fourth hall lies the home to Shecknurd and on occasions the meeting room of himself and Authora. The final and fifth hall lays all the secrets and lost things throughout time. In the 5th hall lies a doorway to the Underworld, Dreomede, the Heavens, Earth, and Norgard.

name: Dimension Crest
description:
Race: None

A hidden dimension that was created long ago to serve as a place between every dimension in existence including those that are also hidden by other means. It is usually housed by the powerful being named Dimension Master.

name: Grandoff
location: Next to Heaven on the east
description:
Race: Sasasian & Tolnick

The home of all magic, it housed all magic before Eve manage to tap into its place and release magic to the rest of the world. Over time magic flowed from the Earth contacting other worlds including the gods. Bewithia manage to use this power to become the first witch and practitioner of magic.

name: Purnog
description:
Race: Various

Similar to its sister schools, Purnog is a place to further the education of a magical entity where normal school wouldn’t be a fitting place for it. Purnog differs as it is a place for more creature like entities to go to school including magical beasts and many of the magical creatures of Aurelia. Although, its residency is limited as most creatures prefer to live in their native habitats. They can easily go to the school at any time through the use of magical amulets provided to each student and faculty at the beginning of the school year.

name: Nature Key
description:
Race: None

Nature key is a resort town for magical beings in Tier, it has one of the largest areas for young children to use their magical aloud without precautions. It is a massive place expanding across numerous dimensional barriers and containing every known theme park ride imaginable including a place to play with imaginary friends from Dreomede. Its southern banks contain the Fountains of Dreams where its local spa is. Its north contains the River of Flakes where one could speak to the dead and hear their stories. While the east and west contains places for over 2 million theme park and water rides. Its center is a large park with carnival rides that are inspired by nearly all human theme park rides that have ever existed.

name: Tantirith
location: Tier (part of the Triangle of Knowledge with Purnog and Hizirinth)
description:
Race: Magical Beings of all kinds

A mutual place that was founded by five powerful magical beings of their times. It houses nearly 10,000 students a year with nearly all 10,000 having magical powers since birth. The school is located on a large mountain surrounded by dense fog, high ridges, large dragons, and sea creatures. It serves as the Triangle of Knowledge with Purnog and Hizirinth and houses many ghosts, magical creatures, beasts, and magical people and things.

The five main halls for students are:
• Chapter of Drake
• Chapter of Eyis
• Chapter of Oceen
• Chapter of Shade
• Chapter of Thorns

Each representing the five leaders in their respected magical communities upon finding the school and sharing their magical history with that respective hall. Images of thousands of magical beings are found throughout the halls and beasts of all kind are seen on the school grounds. Because of a joint magical venture, no lethal harm can be done to anyone on school grounds. This is also a problem as evil beings cannot be lethally harmed unless the barrier around the school is lifted.

name: Hizirinth
location: Tier (part of the Triangle of Knowledge with Tantirith and Purnog)
description:
Race: Magical beings mostly of dark origins

A school known mostly for its deceptive tactics against competing schools and training of black magic for use in evil situations. The school has been awarded honor of truth for the fact that it has been upfront and honest about its status since conception. It has been modeled after Tantirith and houses many halls similar to those found in competing schools. It has many subjects similar to normal schools like Math, Languages, and Science while obtaining many subjects like Lethal Magic, Deadly Spells, and Forgotten Languages 101.

name: Corridor of Bloodspell
description: Each representing an evil magical being that helped build the school in response toward the five creators that helped build Tantirith. It is believed that the Corridor of Night is created by the same being that created the Chapter of Shade at Tantirith.

name: Sea of Life
description:
Race: Gagiel & Leviathans

A sparkling ocean that can be seen from all directions in Heaven. It contains the massive sea creatures of Heaven, the Leviathans. Gagiel lives here where he keeps them at bay and walks around the sea in an attempt to keep it calm and from over flowing. This will happen at the end of all things and Heaven will be flooded.

name: Heaven’s Ocean
description:
Race: None

A massive ocean that could gulf the entire milky way inside of it three times. It is located on the Eastern side of Heaven and has the most beautiful waters compared to anywhere. It serves as the gateway to the Afterlife and no one has ever fully crossed it. On its other sides are the cities of Heaven, the Throne of GOD, and the Gates of Heaven.

name: Elreus
description:
Race: Elreuns

The largest continent on Tier, it is home to many wildlife and magical creatures. Its many states and cities practice both wild magic and creature magic. It is also home to the Black Forest at it’s center.

name: Belkine
description:
Race: Belkians

Home to those whom worship the legend of Belckus and his children the Belki. They usually are covered in markings and practices a range of shadow magic. Belkine is also the home to the largest number of Blood Witches supporters. Because of its actions, it often compared to Russia on Earth and is carefully watched by the High Council.

name: United Realms of Tier
description:
Race: Tierians

A large continent that sits in the center of Moon Ocean. When parts of the Tierian Moon Oka broke off and fell to Tier in ancient times, it became the United Realms of Tier or URT. It is home to millions of mages, thousands of cities, and 60 union states.

name: Rarcoth
description:
Race: Tierians

Rarcoth is one of the most popular cities located in Tier. It the place where many young mages go to explore their first experience in the big city. It has tall buildings and is the birth place of magical technology within the magical community.

name: Land of Time
description:
Race: Arcota

Located in a mysterious place hidden by powerful and ancient magic. This place holds the records of time, both past and present and at its entrance are found the Pillars of Time.

name: Anura
description:
Race: Descendants
Note: School of Angels

Also known as the School of Angels, Anura was first created by the Domaedians in hopes to house future beings which sought protection and teaching from the outside world. Found on a mountain cliff overlooking most of the world, only flying and/or boats can reach this location. The entire location is protected by a vail of light and only Descendants and Domaedians can cross through it. Anura has had over 200 different headmasters and currently is ran by Miada with over 10,000 students and over 4,000 staff members both human and Descendants. The school has over 20 million rooms and is surrounded by a massive forest and rivers. The actual building itself is alive and its heart is buried over 5,000 miles beneath its surface, it’s said that the heart of the building contains powerful Domaedian energy and is sought out by many beings. The core as its called is protected by 7 powerful seraphs that sleep until someone enters the chambers. So far no one has entered the chambers as it’s hidden from all including the headmasters. Over 16 courses are taught at the school including basic courses like English, History, Math, Science, and Health. Larger than any known school on Earth, it is said that this school grows in size every time a new Abnormal is born to accommodate the future possible student.

name: Coldren
description:
Race: None

A place where important figures gather from across the various realms to discuss matters that pertain to their protection and outside threats. Every major council that sits at the top of their respective races, have their own hall here to discuss matters important to their respective races. It is located in a center place between the multiverse within the Realm of Living. Its exact location is a mystery to all except Olerta. Everyone else appears here through the use of powerful magic.

name: The Federation of the Galactic Alliance
description:
Race: None
Note: FGA

The Federation of the Galactic Alliance (FGA) is a collection of planets, stars, and other cosmic bodies that all agreed on a set of rules, space laws, and actions. This massive floating space station is both office, home, school, and battleground for those who visits it. It is found about seven lightyears away from Earth. The E.L.I.T.E Organization found out about its existence once they sent astrologers to a world that is apart of it.

name: E.L.I.T.E Tower
description:
Race: mostly humans

E.L.I.T.E Tower is a massive tower found somewhere on Earth. Its exact location is hidden even from the most elite members of governments. Its primary focus is to provide support services, protections, and relief from both intergalactic and supernatural attacks. Although from a distance, the tower appears to be one tall tower, it’s base is consisting of almost a campus like structure consisting of numerous buildings, houses, underground labs, launchpads, and a large garden around its perimeter. It is the headquarters for the Elite Astrologers at the World Lab on its south side and the E.L.I.T.E Organization at the top of the tower.

name: Askanti or Kingdom of Askanti
description:
Race: Askantians

The original kingdom of Africa long forgotten, its people have been on the continent for nearly 500,000 years and its kingdom in existence for almost 100,000 years. It had major technological advances and even produced weapons beyond the grasp of current standards. It is believed that aliens from another world provided blueprints to make such weapons. The people of Askanti, are known for their technology, love for art, dance, logistics, and flying. Their stories inspired numerous stories including the Egyptians to build the pyramids.

name: Incognito City
description:
Race: humans and androids

Incognito City is known as a high-tech city where gangs and anyone that wants to disappear arrives at to escape the surrounding world. It has holographic walls that are strengthen with advance technology. Giant billboards that follow you upon eye contact, android cops, power dampeners found throughout the city that are controlled by the city officials.

name: Outlook Post
description:
Race: Hunters & humans

Outlook Post is one of the 12 Hunter stations found throughout the world. Their primary goal is to carry out missions against supernatural forces that threaten normal citizens. It is in Los Angeles, California. Hunters here are known for their shapeshifting abilities granted on them by the ancient American Goddess Liberty.

name: Hunter Business of Operations
description:
Race: Hunters & Humans
Note: H.B.O.O

The H.B.O.O is one of the largest hunter stations and the largest type of command center in the world, it has a massive training ground, highly advance agent centers, primary and secondary schooling, government meeting halls, and more. It is in New York City with most of it is located beneath the ground.

name: Hunter Stations
description:
Race: Hunters & Humans

Locations around the world with 12 of them in total. They come in various sizes and are usually masked from the outside, so the rest of the world think they are just normal locations like coffee shops, storefronts, residences, etc. The largest of them is the Outlook Post and the H.B.O.O.

name: Brazil Operations
description: Located beneath a coffee shop.

name: Antarctica Operations
description: Located beneath the central outpost.

name: Tokyo Operations
description: The third largest outpost, it contains a traveling portal powered by dark magic. The giant Gundam acts as its guard although many believe it to be just an inactive attraction.

name: Russian Operations
description: A powerful outpost and probably the most secretive of all the operations and one of the few that the government openly knows about.

name: Africa Operations
description: A massive operations found near present day Askanti but hidden as a ghost town. The Askanti people know of its true operations but has sense worked with the Hunters to protect their lands from supernatural threats.

name: Border Operations
description: A powerful and highly tactful outpost that is charged with protecting our world from supernatural threats that breaches dimensional gateways.

name: Canadian Operations
description: Found in Vancouver downtown area. It operates as a hotel to the public.

name: Egyptian Operations
description: The second African operations that has existed since the ancient Egyptians after it was believed that the Egyptian Gods were threats to mankind.

name: Arctic Operations
description: Powerful operations where Hunters practices powerful Ice Magic, one of the few hunters that can practice magic. Their means of doing so are granted to them through Ice Shards that were left by the Nordic Gods in ancient times.

name: Indian Operations
description: Known for their powerful psychic abilities that were granted to them by the Hindu Gods of ancient times.

name: London Operations
description: Elected three hundreds years ago by the British Royal family, they are known for their stealth and advance anti-magic weapons.

name: Barnethis
description:
Race: Spirits

Barnethis was a powerful city before it sunk beneath the ocean, like many other cities that are no longer on Earth, it appeared in the Astral Plane along with those that died when it sunk.

name: The Void
description:
Race: Chaos, Leviathans, Belckus, the Belki

Unlimitedly boundless place that is seen as the darkness throughout the universe. From its core is where dark matter is born. After their fight with The Ultimate Power, Chaos, the Leviathans, and later Belckus and his Belki were banished here. No known gates exist allowing entrance or exit from this domain. For a being to ever leave this place, the Realm of Living must cease to exists. The

name: White Space
description:
Race: First Ones, The Neither

Opposite to the Void, the White Space is home to the First Ones and is birthplace of the Domi Mages, the first members of the High Council, and home of The Neither (Anka). It has no known entrances nor exists and will cease to exist upon The Ultimate Power absence from Heaven’s throne.

name: The Sanctuary
description:
Race: Domi Mages

Appearing as a castle with giant steel walls made of pure silver and diamond crusted pillars. Once acknowledged by ancient mages as a place where the gods convened but actually unknowingly as the place of their ancestors the Domi Mages. Not much is known of its interior other than the Grand Meeting Hall which has been drawn by the Elitshians when the first prophet foretold of all superior beings meeting here at the end of the age of magic.

name: Solidar
description:
Race: Desert Worms & Sand Plants

A desert world that is home to giant sand worms and active sand plants of which are either ate by the sand worms or are their predators. This hostile world has been known to serve as a filming location for galactic television mediums.

name: The God Planet
description:
Race: Godayns

The God Planet is one of the largest worlds in the universe. It has over 1000 continents and over a million cities and towns. Its citizens are known as the Godayns and appear with pure white skin, with the shortest Godayn is six feet, and can lift twice their weight.

name: Metro City
location: 1 lightyear outside of our solar system
description:
Race: Metroids

A futuristic cyber city that exists to float on an asteroid and is the size of New York City. It exists about 1 lightyear outside of our solar system. It is home to about 1 million citizens and has five distinct boroughs.

name: Gilverd
description:
Race: Various

A small world with 10-degree weather and almost unbearable except for penguin like creatures and people with fur coat looking bodies. It has various small villages scattered across the world and it has two moons. Each moon are pure iced asteroids.

name: Moon Ring
description:
Race: Various

Moon ring consists of 12 moon like worlds with millions of citizens appearing almost angelic with small wings and proud statures.

name: Mermadic Kingdom
description:
Race: Mermadic People

Sunk beneath the Atlantic Ocean by ancient dark magic. Its people were turned to mermaid like creatures by the same magic that sunk their country. Home to various cities including the famed Atlantis.

name: Atlantis
description:
Race: Atlanteans

Atlantis is one of the most powerful and famous cities in the Mermadic Kingdom. Sunk along with the rest of the country, it was home to powerful descendants and mages. Humans worked in the city while the mages and descendants were treated like gods and royalty. To explore the ever-changing world above, the vast Atlantis has made numerous contracts with various above surface countries.

name: United Universal Alliance
description:
Race: Multiple Galaxies

A federation of galaxies all agreeing on equal terms, laws, protections, rights, and issues. Their central meeting place is located on the UUA Central Campus found in Quadrant 1019. There are a total of 88 departments that make up the UUA and each are headed by generals of which are the respected spokesperson for their galaxy.

name: United Galactic Alliance
description:
Race: Multiple Worlds

Like the UUA (United Universal Alliance), the UGA are an alliance of multiple governments spread across numerous worlds. Collectively they decide on the wellbeing of their respected world including agreements like to not to go to war with one another.

name: Quadrants
description:
Race: Multiple races

Vast spaces that span across the universe, so far there are 10,000 known quadrants. Each are believed to have up to a hundred galaxies.

name: Prehistoria
description:
Race: Prehistorians

A giant island that is located below Antartica’s surface surrounded by a warm sea. Only a few people outside of Prehistoria knows of its existence. The Prehistoria stories take place here, while the Demoys also live here and have for nearly 140 years. The laws here is that time moves slower. Large magma rivers enhanced with time magic allowed Prehistoria to remain hidden from the rest of the world.

name: Food Town
description:
Race: The Townspeople

An enchanted place located at the north of the Black Forest. It is home to magical people with appearance of Earthly and magical food items. It is believed by the rest of the magical communities that this place was created by fairies along with Candylane Village, Melody Hills, Peppermint Valley, and Bakery Hilltop to house magical spirits.

name: Candylane Village
description:
Race: Candylane Villagers

Creatures of various shapes, sizes, and races coexisting in a magical place built to appear as an enchanted candy inspired city. One of its most popular sports is racing and its challengers are from the popular Candylane Racers.

name: Peppermint Valley
description: Town centre of Candylane Village and one of its main locations. It is also home to the Peppermint King, ruler of Candylane Village. It has many buildings including a massive charge made of peppermints.

name: Melody Hills
description:
Race: Melodians

Home to Strawberry Darline and her many companions. It is a sweet-smelling place that is located at the northwest side of the Black Forest.

name: Ridlan City
description:
Race: Humans & Lightning Stardust

A big city located somewhere in Ohio. It is where Lightning Stardust takes place and a place, she calls home for several years before returning to her world.

name: Bakery Hilltop
description:
Race: Melodians & Strawberry Darline

Town centre located in heart of Melody Hills. Its buildings and shops appear as real bakery items like donuts and tea mugs.

name: Shadowbrooke
description:
Race: Humans & Kyra Lazaron

Small town in Kansas USA where some of the worlds most dangerous battles have taken place. It is home to the main story of Spell Reign. It was nearly destroyed before Kyra Lazaron restored it and erased its residents’ memories.

name: Garden of Eden
location: Center of Heaven (Once on Earth, now called Africa)
description:
Race: Once Adam and Eve

The most beautiful garden decorated with numerous trees including the Tree of Life of which all life flows. From its roots are the many dimensions that exists within this Universe. It is located in the center of Heaven, two levels below the Throne of GOD. It once was located on Earth until Santaniel invaded it and influence the first humans there. Once Eve became the first witch, the garden was removed from Earth and behind it, the land it once sat became known as Africa.

name: Elrian Ocean
description:
Race: Mermadic Kingdom is located on its floor

Tier’s third largest ocean, it is in the center of the world and is known for its glowing sands that form the beaches. It is the most beautiful of all the oceans and is a popular destination for those whom want to visit the magical cities of the Mermadic kingdom located on its floors.

name: Black Ocean
description:
Race: Aquatic creatures

Tier’s fourth largest ocean, it’s waters are dark as night and is home to some of the most vile creatures found in Tier. Borders have been set up along its coast to prevent diving and fishing.

name: Moon Ocean
description:
Race: Aquatic creatures

Tier’s second largest ocean and the only ocean that is entirely surrounded by continents.

name: Vulkan Ocean
description:
Race: Aquatic creatures

Vulkan Ocean is named after the God of Fire and Forge, Vulkan. It is believed in ancient times, Vulkan took refuge here after the battle of Mostibik. Its surface is oddly consisting of fire but the surface waters are nearly frozen. It is Tier’s largest ocean and is located at the northern most part of the planet.

name: Nigerikarte
description:
Race: Shadow Creatures, Tonik

Nigerikarte or often called the Nightmare Realm is actually a city found toward the north side of the Shadow Realm. It houses all the nightmares, fears, anger, and other bad emotions from the waking world. It is ruled by the banished king, Tonik. The rest of the shadow realm is to the south of it while it is connected to the Imaginarium to the northwest and to Dreomede to direct north of it.

name: Ostafair
description: A maiden town with a large kingdom made up of rubies and stones erected at its center. Its humble beginnings was that of a tragic end when its royal family died leaving behind Queen Annabelle to take the thrown.

name: Laurel Hall
description: A long hall which houses many cities in different rooms. Where the hall is located no one knows. To get to this location, one must wish really hard or it won’t appear. It is ruled by Princess Cassandra

name: Mint Kingdom
description: A peaceful place with large mushroom like structures on the top of its buildings. The people are usually singing a joyous song with many animals able to speak human language. It is ruled by Kohan Mushroom.

name: Jerule
description: Sir Will Castings took over the kingdom after overthrowing his father. Believing to be a good guy, his attitude changed when his mother was banished from the kingdom and he grew even more evil when he believed although mistaken that his half-brother fell in love with his soon to be bride. Jerule is a mighty kingdom erected on a large rock. It is home to great warriors and has giant swords erected on all corners of the town.

name: Fairy Village
description: Located on the far eastern side of Fairytale City. It is ruled by Prince Faren. Populated by all types of fairies, it is one of the most popular places within the mentioned stories of the Seven Kingdoms. It is seen as a humble place with large trees, giant animals, pixie dust floating throughout the sky, good smelling scents, and glowing crystals erected near every building for light sources.

name: Mushroom Valley
description: A peaceful place with large mushroom like structures on the top of its buildings. The people are usually singing a joyous song with many animals able to speak human language. It is ruled by Kohan Mushroom.

name: Availion
description: A beautiful city with flowing streams connecting at its center. It glows in the night because of floating flowers on the surface of the streams. It is ruled by Princess Antivail.

name: Tower Central
description: A large technological city that surrounds itself by large statue like robots. It is ruled by Princess Domina and her parents. Believed to be one of the most technological advance places in all the realms.

name: Ancient Soamr
description: A city surrounded by sand and large sand dunes. It is believed that the city sits on top of the largest basin of rivers that connects below. The rivers flow into all the rivers of the world. It is ruled by Impresss Lurella.

name: Fairytale City
description: A floating city that connects the other realms of the magical realm of Tier. Fourteen of those realms are ruled by royal families of whose stories intersects with each other. This city is large with buildings made up of crystals, fairydust, and giant floating orbs which protects it. It is ruled by Fairygood Weather.

name: North Pole
description:
Race: Dwarves, Claus family, Elves

Usually, a peaceful place consisting of joyous dwarves. It is a far away from humans and is surrounded by a snow globe enchanted by the Claus’. It consists of several mini villages all circling Christmas Tower.

name: Oidhche Shamhna toilichte
description:
Note: Halloween in Scottish Gaelic

A place where the spirits of the dead often see while crossing to the afterlife. It is located somewhere in the Astral Plane and is decorated with almost every traditional Halloween treasures.

name: Tok’nu
description: A magical world and one of the worlds of the Magical Community, it is a vast sprawling place of mages and magical creatures much like its sister planet Tier. It is pictured as having cities with buildings as tall as any on Earth and magical technology was birth here.

name: Spell World
description: A magical world a part of the Magical Community. It is mostly home to Wizards, Elementals, a few witches, magical creatures, and fairy folk. It is as far from Tier as Earth from Jupiter.

name: Magical Community
location: Other side of Pluto and 15th planet from the Blue Sun
description: A collection of 14 worlds existing on the other side of our solar system. If someone was on Pluto, they would be able to see the furthest planet of its solar system. Its system is like ours as that each planet moves in a circular ring around the sun. The sun, however, is blue and emits both heat and coldness, universally controlling the seasons on the magical worlds.

name: Vesper
location: Behind Pluto and 14th planet from the Blue Sun
description:
Race: Ice Valkens

Vesper is a small world on the other side of Pluto that is made up of mostly ice and has a surface covered in mountains of stone and ice fields. It has no known residence however many believe that Ice Valkens migrated from this world after their food source disappeared.

name: Granjur
description:
Race: Fairies

Granjur is a large planet and sixth largest in the Magical Community, it is the 13th farthest planet from the Blue Sun. It is green in color and is home to many fairy folk. It has a portal in the heart of the Black Forest.

name: Black Forest
description:
Race: Fairies, mermaids, mermen, GODS, dwarves, fairy folk

Black Forest or Isle of Fairies is a magical place that is known throughout the Magical Community as a sprawling place of magical marketplaces, lushes greenlands, beautiful waters, and home to the Fairy Folk. Its oceans are also home to the Mermadic Kingdom with gates to other worlds found within the oceans and thick forests in the center of the planet. The center of the black forest has a gate that travels directly to Tier and is close to Tantirith. The gate doesn’t close and causes some of the forest to grow outward through the gate into Tier. Because of this, many fear it and warn to never enter this place.

name: Galrow
description:
Race: Varies

Galrow is a fairly small planet and home to dessert like beings. Most of the world’s surface is covered in sand including its homes. Because of its dense clouds, very few outsiders know how this world really looks.

name: Shadow World
description:
Race: Varies

The only known world to be the front of the Shadow Realm. Because of its unique position as a place stuck half way between a black hole. On the other end of the black hole is the Shadow Realm. Half of this world is disconnected from the rest because of a large blackhole like event happening in the center of it, causing no cities or life to live near it on either side for hundreds of miles. The world is however a bustling world of thousands of cities, countries, and magical farmlands. Because of its unique position, it a place of strategic power and is often a place where battles are fought because of the Black Hole’s radiant power.

name: Onray
location: Closest planet to the Blue sun
description:
Race: Varies

Large planet with a hundred moons, it is closest to the Blue Sun and has over 15 different seasons. Its beautiful scenery is a popular vacation spot for mages from numerous worlds and it has a calm atmosphere. War has been outlawed for almost three thousand years and it rotates slightly slower than the rest of the planets. It is the home to the High Council and the First Ones.

name: Blue Sun
description:
Race: Sun Mages

A large blue sun about the size of our own sun, its radiant blue glow emits both heat and ice from its surfaces creating a multiple seasonal effect to all its orbiting planets. It is one of the few Suns with orbital rings, with the planets themselves living within those large rings. From the distance, one can assume that it’s a large planet until a closer look determines it’s a star and its rings are made up of planets and light emitting from them.

name: Vehtrah
description:
Race: Varies

This world is a large world within the Magical Community that over time has seen its water levels rise to its skies. It’s residents have since evolved into aquatic lifeforms and built gates that connects it to various other aquatic based places including the Mermadic Kingdom.

name: Onis
description:
Race: Light Mages & Elves
Note: World of Light

Home to the Light Mages, this beautiful planet is covered in radiant light and produces its own sunlight. It can be seen from the distance on Pluto. Here some of the largest gates ever constructed for space travel have been created. It also is the second largest world with a high population of elves after the Black Forest.

name: Volcanos
description:
Race: Vulkan, Dwarves, magical creatures

A large forge world created by Vulkan as part of the Magical Community. It is visited by many races as it serves as the workshop for many weapons known to the GODS. It was Vulkan’s home before Mostibik.

name: Lupurr
description:
Race: Magical Creatures

A vast world with mostly greenlands, oceans, and large fields. This world is known for its unique vegetation. Although mostly barren, this world is home to various magical creatures though no known mages.

name: Tier
description:
Race: Varies

One of the most populous magical worlds in the Magical Community. It is similar in size to Earth and has close ties to the world. It was the first world to have a magical gate and its earliest races engineered powerful mechanics to allow them dimensional travel. It has one of the most extensive transportation systems, home to the Royal Family, largest capital of the Magical Community, and center point for many conventions by powerful mages.

name: Astral High
description:
Race: Ghosts, Spirits, Gods of the Underworld
Note: Ghost School

A large school, Astral High is found within the Astral Plane and contains many important links to the other seven schools of the Magical Ring. It is often called Ghost School by foreigners.

name: Aurelia
description:
Race: Aurelians, Battle Guardians, Spell Creatures

A large world consisting of Elves known as Aurelians and creatures known as Spell Creatures. It is the primary location in the Battle Guardians stories and has a direct link via the Magical Community Transit Network to Tier. It is about the size of Mars and has a similar red glow surrounding it although it experiences four seasons, similar weather patterns, and landforms as Earth and Tier.

name: Magical Community Link
description:
Note: MCL

The MCL (Magical Community Link) is a large transit network that connects the different worlds together through a magical rail line, magical buses, and other supernatural vehicles. It has numerous sub-networks across the different worlds including the Tier Transit Authority on Tier. The High Council are directly responsible for the network’s upkeep and expansion.  The Dimensional Gates are also part of the network.

name: Dimensional Gates
description: Large doorways that connect to various worlds across the Universe. Mapped by the ancient mages that created them, they were inspired to connect the different worlds and build a connected network federation.

name: Brettwood
description:
Race: Varies

A town located south of Chicago, its mysterious and has a lot of paranormal activity happening within it. Most people stay away from its almost perfect appearance because of eerie vibes they receive. It is the base of the Lifestyle stories.

name: Lost Mountain
description:
Race: Lost Boys & Peter Pan

An enchanted mountain that appears to lose children and Blackbeard. It is one of several gateways to the Black Forest. It is found on Earth and has a massive amount of fairy dust floating through the air. It is home to the Lost Boys and Peter Pan.

name: Gardenia
description:
Race: Yonrohs, Yosubut, Elitsyian Gods

A vast garden like state found in the lower parts of Heaven that was built specifically by the Primordial One Yonrohs. It’s status as part of heaven is highly debated, nonetheless has become a staple for being tightly related by Yonrohs and the birth of Yosubut and the Lesser Gods.

name: Valken Huldrum
description:
Race: Valkens

A large world that serves as one of the moons to Liumus. It’s home to the Valkens and has a darker appearance than the often bright and serene Liumus.

name: Terra
description:
Race: Terrians

An Earth like world that appears almost exactly like Earth in almost every detail. To the point where the Outer World crew thought they arrived back on Earth, shortly after leaving through one of the gates. This place is exactly like Earth in every way down to its citizens appearing to be ancestors to humans. It is believed that they appeared on Earth, populating it, leaving hundreds of years later taking with them advance technology they once used in ancient times.

name: Luna
description:
Race: Lunians

A moon similar in size as our own, it orbits Terra and appears as a shinning star in the night sky. It has beautiful scenery, luscious rivers, large mountains, cities, and its residents speak in a Latin styled language.

name: Aura World
description:
Race: Aura Beasts & Aurayans

A large world that mimics Aurelia in almost every way except that its nights are longer, its days shorter, and because of its strong wave of energy that flows through the air. It causes the landforms and its residents to have glowing markings. Its Spell Creatures known as Aura Beasts are also affected by the glowing markings, allowing them enhanced strength and attacks, their speed however is reduced. Behemoth attempted to collapse both worlds and almost succeeded when the Akuma opened a portal to his dimension.

name: Demonic Dimension
description:
Race: Children of Lucifer

Home to all of Lucifer’s children, they convene inside of large temple like structure at the center of the dimension with a spirit form of their father. Behemoth was the most recent member that left this dimension to no longer return at his defeat to the Battle Guardians.

name: Moon City
location: Between light and dark side of the moon
description:
Race: Mages

Found between the dark and light side of the moon. Moon City is a place where mages visit to shop, party, and vacation. It has beautiful silver and blue rivers, a protective dome around it, and tall buildings that allow it to resemble London and NYC. In its center is the Moon Mall where many shops and magical items can be found.

name: Moon Mall
description:
Race: Mages (no residents)

A historically large and highly visited mall that is in the center of Moon City. It has many beautiful features including a large Magical Creature Zoo.  It also has a train station that stops at four points around the mall.

name: Magical Creature Zoo
description:
Race: Magical creatures
Note: MCZ

Zoos that have numerous magical creatures across the Magical Communities. They contain hundreds, some has thousands of Magical Creatures ranging from numerous species even extinct ones. One of the smallest zoos can be found within the Moon Mall in Moon City.

name: Techno Hyrum
description:
Race: Galactic Beings

A collection of planets where technologies are at its most advance. The technology found within this system are the most advance of any other system to the point where many of its systems became sentient. There are currently 6 worlds within this system, 2 of which with cooperation with Hasbro are from the Transformers universe.

name: Beta 5
description: A small world where insectoids are located and are looked upon as a desolate world from Zeta One.

name: Theta Vi
description: A large world where there is beautiful nature made up of wires and technically advance robots. The bots here are humanoids with advance communication abilities.

name: Omega Zone
description: The largest of the worlds in this system and home to the Omegadroids and Alphadroids and the other Galactic Beings. It is the most populated of the other worlds with billions of bots.

name: Sentinel Black
description: A large world and sister world to Omega Zone. It is home to a large machine that creates bots that are sent out to various worlds to take them over.

name: New Elitshia
description:
Race: New Elitshians

New Elitshia is a manmade country that is in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. It vary purpose was originally to be a modern day replica to the original Elitshia with all the original cities revived in modern time. The new country has all the original Elitshian ideas and structures modernized and replicated. New Elitshia is home to most of Elite Comics storylines with Central City being the most prominent location of most characters and their on going battles and lives. New Elitshia is about the size of the entire Ocenia area with Central City being about the size of NYC. Transportation in New Elitshia is controlled by NLTA which is based off of AMATA a semi-real transit authority. NLTA means New Elitshia Transit Authority.

name: Elitshia
location: Used to be in the Pacific Ocean
description:
Race: Elitshians

Elitshia the continent which houses the Elitshian Mythology was predicted to have been about the same size as Australia. This estimate left many to believe that Australia is the modern Elitshia that for some reason lost its history and started anew without any traces of the Elitshians and their many stories. Elitshia from afar could been seen as Utopia, with nourished waters, buildings erected of diamond and glass, and waterfalls that overlooked the many peaceful lands. Elitshia was estimated at having had approximately 143 cities and about 50 villages and towns, its people probably ranged from over 40,000 or based from stories about 300,000 people in all.  Its climate was very humid but with occasional raining and a vast amount of storms. Alongside the east, west, and northern sides of Elitshia lied several islands known as the Islands of Elitshia. In its center lied the largest city and birthplace of its language, Linius. Along with the islands were banks and ship ports on the south side which were used for trading and shipping. To connect with several uninhabitable islands, the Elitshians built bridges called the Pinel Connectors and they were made of marble and stone. The West, East, and South Gulfs were all considered not just trading spots but known as gateways similar to the Japanese and Chinese gateways that were found located in the lakes and seas near their homelands. These Gulfs the Elitshians thought to be the gateways to the underworld, heaven, and the Other World. Two seas lied at the western parts of Elitshians but would submerge into the Pacific Ocean along with the Indian Oceans. They were called the Prosch and Mountain Edge Seas. They got their names from two cities. The Pinel Connectors were destroyed by an army from Invasia “an island that gained independence from Elitshia” when they didn't want the continent to gain more power. Elitshia was either destroyed or named something else in the later parts of history. But one thing is for certain its name will live on forever. Below are over 100 cities that were located in Elitshia.

name: Y’borus
description:
Race: Y’brukahs

A mythical tree that was created by the Domi Mages to preserve the fate of existence. From its branches lies the infinite number of realms. From its stems lies the flow of Time, Magic, Matter, Life, Death, Mass, Power, and Will. Its exact location is unknown. From its existence all things have tried to find it but none had been successful.

name: Invasia
description:
Race: Invasians

Was once a beautiful city of Elitshia, until an evil unnamed emperor took control and led an army out west to destroy its alliance with Elitshia. After this Invasia became its own authority and because of their independence, its people didn't believe in magic, gods, or any other force or rule but their own. In the end a big storm destroyed the city about 2,000 years before the destruction of Elitshia

name: Legacy City
description:
Race: Legacies

A city full of highly advance computer generated places and people. It has since become real by combining human DNA with computerized components creating all places and things inside of the city. The city is the future of Central city and after Central City was destroyed, intellectual beings used new technology to recreate the city. This time the city rose higher and grew wider than before and its new name became Legacy City and its people became known as the Legacies.

name: Stonehendge Valley
description:
Race: Old Worlders

Enemies to the residences of Legacy City, the Old Worlders believe that the old world and its ideas & creations are how the world should be. Thus creating a war against Legacy City to bring the world back to normal and defeat the Legacies to do it.

name: Rock Nation
description:
Race: Old Worlders

Considered the only survivors of the Old World, they are the eldest and most intelligent of Stonehendge Valley. Their city is one of the few remaining cities of New Elitshia.

name: Old World
description:
Race: Elitshians

Residences of the original Earth before it was destroyed, the Old World has no location as it is just a term to represent a world before the great battle of gods and mortals.

name: New World
description:
Race: Elitshians, Legacies

A term used to describe the new World after the great battle between Gods and mortals. It is made up of mostly technology with little remains of the Old World. It’s new center is called Legacy City where most residences are from.

name: Arvokian Mts
description: A wide range of mountains that expand around Legacy city and although it has no residences, it is home to several of the New Beasts.

name: Gamuga
description:
Race: Gamis

Hidden by large thick trees, this village has grown in incredible size over the centuries. To the point of becoming one of the largest cities in Africa. Because of its hidden nature, the rest of the world has become almost unaware of its existence.

name: Refidge
location: South of the Mississippi River (town disappeared somewhere after 1735)
description: Popular in the Shadow Refuge stories, this town has been of the most prominent locations where many supernatural forces reside to find the ancient power hidden somewhere in its town limits.

name: Tomid
description:
Race: Tomidians

A tropical region found near the south of the country. It has tall pine trees and locals who sing and dance. The main geological study showcases that this city seems to never change nor age. Its large arch buildings have been one of the largest tourist attractions. The beaches around it seems to glitter like diamond.

name: Lugia Campgrounds
description: The lugia campgrounds are a special place where those that have pass away are remembered and their graves erected high to be seen by nearby villages. Spirits of the dead live here in serenity and nearby locals worship these grounds as a sacred place.

Fences of rock was built around the pit and guards sat near them to ensure safety of its people.

Its main mode of transportation is vehicles and the NLTA which runs throughout the entire country.

name: Sector A
description: Found in the northern part of New Elitshia, this beautiful place is home to mostly schools, musuems, and many other educational sections of Elitshia. Almost all Elitshian residences attend school somewhere here, its highly protected by giant gates and violence is forbidden here and a strict security has been enforced here for safety.

name: Sector B
description: Located in the Eastern part of New Elitshia, a place of glamour and elegance, so beautiful, it has been called the land of the rich, like Sector A, it is protected by giant gates. It has been called the Hamptons and Beverly Hills of Elitshia with its big structures, houses, schools, and beautiful landscapes.

name: Sector C

Its buildings are closely modeled after buildings found in New York City, Los Angeles, and Miami. A massive explosion was caused in the center portion of the city, infecting the residences with supernatural abilities.

name: Sector D

name: Sector F

name: Sector G

It is also the 2nd oldest part of New Elitshia, almost being over 200 years old and has since seen its population grow because of its cheap living and the fact that it sits near one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. The city since about 40 years ago, been enclosed in a giant ceiling less dome constricting of heighten security to help make the city more secure.

name: Sector H

It has been moved several times eventually settling at the southern peak of New Elitshia because to its beautiful scenary and great tempatures. The city is protected by a giant brick and glass wall with giant telescopes around it. The city has many educational properties including museums, labrotories, schools, giant telescopes, etc.

name: Sector S

name: Sector U

name: Sector V
description: Small residential city

name: Sector W

name: Sector X
