name: Sector Y
description: Small business district with skyscrapers that are some of the largest in the region.

name: Sector Z
description: A giant government driven city with similarities to Area 51, it’s also the home to many artifacts and mysterious objects that have once fell or came to Earth.

name: Sector One
description: A giant area with no residences nor businesses and is enclosed by a giant dome, this area is the location of many gateways that leads to many different worlds including Aurealia, Lium, The Underworld, and Aru. Unknowngst the New Elitshia and others of Earth, this place appeared out of nowhere and has since been called the Realm of Realms and the center doorway lies Olerta’s home. This area can only be entered by someone of supernatural abilities, this city can only be found by a psychic and only someone destine to come to this place can enter its gates.

name: Conshetta
description:
Race: Consheias

A beautiful place that houses the Fountain of Life and Purity. Graced with beauty and place in the Heavens, it is tended by Smod and her nymphs. It was once set to flames by the Valkens but recovered within seconds. It is believed that this sacred garden was once the great creator god's favorite place to play as a child. The Fountain of Life and Purity stood at 20 feet tall with golden and silver jewels decorating it. Representing eternal youth and innocence, both the garden and the fountain would be protected by an energy barrier created by Yonrohs that would release a powerful field of energy that could take the life of an immortal.

name: Authorose
description:
Race: Authorians

City famous for its discovery by Authora, unlike most other cities this city was both beautiful, rich with many precious minerals, and protected by gods. Authorose served as birthplace of teachers, poets, dancers, inventors, artists, and most famously the Virgins of Authorose. The virgins served as the assistants to Authora. Although by legend it was considered the smartest place on Earth and bore very few residents of its own. It sat at the edge of the Northern part of Elitshia. Over ten thousand ports lined up on its edge and its coasts stretched as far to the Eastern and Western parts of Elitshia. It was the largest province not city in Elitshia based on land.

name: Lost Valley
description:
Race: the undead

A place where the dead dances and sings. On the 31st of October, 24th of December, 1st of January, and the 1st of April this place appears in various places on Earth. On these dates, the dead comes to Earth to relive their lives in celebration.

name: Word Town
description:
Race: Elitshians

The city that once existed somewhere closes to the center of Elitshia. It belonged to its self and had no country such as Eastern, Western, Central, Southern, or Northern Elitshia claiming it. The reason behind this city was to be where all weapons and great inventions begun and created. Once sighted, Volkanos took his hand and dug up the city and lifted it to the skies where he then works from as his workshop. In memory of this place another city was created in Center Elitshia and is one of the most important business districts in Elitshia.

name: Trade Island
description:
Race: Trade Island Workers

One of the cities that is an island that lies so close to Elitshia that a bridge later connected the two. Here the many merchandise of the world are imported and exported to and from Elitshia. People do not live here and only markets and businesses are allowed.

name: Wilheim Manor
description: The Wilheim Manor is a large house that is haunted by over hundred ghosts that have either been killed, died by natural cause, and supernatural causes. Because of the massive amount of supernatural activity that has happened in the house, it causes anyone that dies here to stay locked inside of the house for eternity. The house is found in Willowbrooke.

name: Willowbrooke
description:
Race: Elitshian

A seaside town that is known for its mysterious and supernatural activities that has attracted to it. One of its most prominent buildings is the grade A listed Wilheim Manor which was one of the few homes that have existed since its founding.

name: High Priestess
description:
Race: Street Deviants

On the surface, this shop appears as any other novelty shop with the exception that it is the base of operations of the Street Deviants. In the front are mysterious artifacts, crafted objects, skulls, voodoo attire and products, and an aura of supernatural activity. In the back is a large room where the Street Deviants have advance computers, equipment, and separate rooms for them to operate and sleep. It is the shop of Mistress Voodoo.

name: House of Sanctarium
description:
Race: Devious Clowns

A large oval shaped building that sits on a small island near the edge of Elitshia’s outer 1st ring. It has numerous entrances and over the years been home to a long list of villains who called it their headquarters. Rumors are that it was created by the city’s first real villain and in their death, willed it out to The Ringleader.

name: Fire Lands
description: Located on the southeastern side of Aurelia far from most other landforms mostly because of its intense heat and mountainous range. This area is mostly covered with rocks, rivers of lava, and flames arising from its grounds.

name: Ocean Kingdom
description: Metropolis like city located in the Moradian Sea. It is about the size of North America on Earth and was found nearly 10,000 years ago by divers at the Barbian Coast. It is guarded by mermaids and its king Poseidon and appears like pure crystals and diamonds with fishes often circling its entrances.

name: Sky Temple
description: Metropolis like city floating above most of Aurelia often hidden by giant clouds. It is believed that ancient magic holds up this floating city and that it will collapse on the world below at the ends of time marking the Apocalypse. At its center is the home of Iris, Goddess of Rainbow.

name: Arctic Islands
description: Located at the Northwestern part of Aurelia, this freezing cold area contains mountains, hills, valleys, and a city located at its center made of ice, snow, and rocks. At its southern edge is the River of Norcasis.

name: Aurelia Sand dunes
description: Giant hills, valleys, and cliffs of sand with glowing crystal like structures arising from the ground. Surrounded by giant trees and giant statues, this location is mostly secluded and because of the deadly creatures located in this region it is forbidden to enter unless accompanied by a Guardian Creatures.

name: Plane of Light
description: Located in another dimension believed to be the Heaven of Aurelia where most Light types live. This place is one of the most beautiful lands of all realms and can only be reached by the dead or by powerful use of magic.

name: Dreamland
description: An island located in the North Ocean. Humans, animals, Aurelians, and Creature Guardians travel to this world once they fall asleep. Its pictured as a beautiful world with vast environments and magical creatures that roam it.

name: Desserts of Time
description: Located at the edge of East Ocean, this barren land contains deadly creatures and giants that live within the mountains and some Aurelians have built their cities out of rock and trees. Diamond City is the capital of the Desserts of Time.

name: Phoenix Forest
description: A beautiful land of overgrown trees and giant overlooking mountains and deep valleys. It is the home of most legendary creatures and different species of phoenixes. This forest like terrain is protected by a barrier like rainbow which connects to the land of the gods

name: Silverwood
description: Giant sized city guarded by over 10,000 smaller cities with its inner core protected by giant steel machines that appears as giants. This county is mostly known as the birthplace of all Aurelians and is the oldest region in Central Aurelia.

name: Golden Arch
description: A giant land located on most of the western part of Aurelia and contains a miniature portion of land for each known type of creature in Aurelia. It’s mostly jungle, forest, and giant cities located around its center with mountains and deserts serving its northern and southern regions. The West Ocean is on its western border with the Ancient Mines of Aurelia on its east.

name: Ancient Mines of Aurelia
description: Located on the eastern portion of the Golden Arch and the northern tip of Desserts of Time. This landform is mostly old ruins that once resembled cities found in the middle of giant cliffs.

name: River of Death
description: Unlike most other rivers found in Aurelia, this river is the longest river ranging from Plane of Light to the Underworld. The river at its halfway point holds the City of Marture which appears when someone is on the edge of death.

name: Underworld
description: Located at the lowest part of Aurelia and is connected by the River of Death to the rest of Aurelia. It appears as a giant city in the middle of a cavern of rocks, lava, and fire.

name: Aurelia City
description: Giant city located at the heart of Aurelia pictured similar to New York City and is the size of Australia. The tallest building is located at its center and is the tallest building in all of Aurelia.

name: Cartia
description: A city located at the edge of North Ocean with the Port of North Aurelia located at its northeastern edge. The city is guarded by giant trees and located at the northern front of the Forest of Knowledge.

name: Daegun
description: A city known for its farmers and middle class workers. It’s located on the southwestern side of Aurelia.

name: Vex
description: A city of the rich with golden structures located throughout its core and diamond like structures located at the very edge of its harbor. Vex is located across the Temple of the Oracles.

name: Oldun
description: An old city located at the edge of Toyland on the Southside of Aurelia. Its views can see the South Ocean from giant overlapping cliffs and ridges.

name: Temple of the Oracles
description: The major most temples located in Aurelia. It contains all the knowledge of the future and is home of the Royal Family as they watch the world, its history and future. The temple or castle is located overlapping Aurelia City by a crystal like bridge.

name: Psychic Valley
description: Located at the Northern part of Aurelia, this mountainous range of villages and cities are found hidden from sight and can only be accessed by the Lost Map and magic.

name: Dark Worlds
description:
Considered one of the two moons of Aurelia. Once part of Aurelia, this world was split by powerful wizards and was separated once the war of the lands begun. Lord Behemoth and his minions rule this world and are often considered the Shadowlands.

Trimium, Home of the Gods

City of gold and diamonds, this city floats near the Sky Temple and can only be accessed by the Rainbow bridge. This city is ruled by Zeus on the eastern side and by Odin on the western side. The giants rule the southern side of this realm.

name: Blederith
description: The Mirror World

name: Toyland
description: A land made of Lego like parts and is ruled by the Toy King. Its location lies near the Birthlands and is protected by giant Gargoyles.

name: Prehistoric Highlands
description: A forest like realm with mountains, hills, valleys, and no Aurelians. This prehistoric location is home to the dinosaur creatures and was once the only place located in Aurelia until magic was born and imprisoned this land in the past. Only access is through the Cavern of Time which in return is located on the Island of Time (the southeastern portion of Aurelia.

name: Land of the Machines
description: A place located at the Western part of Aurelia in the West Ocean. It is connected by a giant 5,000 mile bridge that can be crossed easily by the train or planes. It is mostly made of steel, metal, and machines.

name: Birthlands
description: Located at the center portion of all of Aurelia near Aurelia City. This place is the birthplace of all creatures and life in general and has direct access to both the Plane of Light and the Underworld. The gods created this location so new souls can be birthed into the world through forms of eggs and nursery.

name: Healing Centers
description: Serving as the major hospitals and healing hubs in Aurelia, there are over 145 centers across the world and each have their own caretakers appearing as nurses or doctors and each has its own OGGUNNY assisting. The main one located in Aurelia City is the largest and at its core is Dr. Aresta who provides starter guides for Battlers & Protectors. They are often designed to appear similar to Soul Readers on the roof and sides and are somewhat homes for many lost Aurelians and creatures.

name: Forests of Aurelia
description: As seen in the first couple of episodes of the comics, the forests are widespread and are home of elfish Aurelians known as the Tree People whom roam the forests in an attempt to live and work. They commute throughout Aurelia finding food and working on different projects, as appose to other Aurelians. Tree people aren’t as intelligent and technology prone as they are used to their old ways and their minimal magical skills.

name: Soul Realm
description: The soul realm is a mysterious place that exists beyond the Dreamland. It is only accessible through Seals and is pictured as a mountainous range with hills, silver rivers, high beams erected above all else. This land appears with the sealed monsters floating in mystical orbs, used to heal them and preserve their natural energy.

name: Imaginarium
location: Located between the Shadow and Dream Realms
description: An imaginative place where everyone goes to even if temporarily. At one point when he fell into a deep sleep unable to awake. Kendo Lazaron mentioned that he had to perform trials to awake, and others have also mentioned that it is a place for those stuck inside of a coma. It is linked to Dreomede and Nigerakarte through a bridge made of silver and dreamdust.

name: Astral Plane
location: Below Realm of Living and above the Underworld
description:
Race: Spirits, ghosts, phantoms, ghouls, shadows

One of the 14 Realms. The Astral Plane came into being through the actions of the first death. The realm grew and intertwined into the Realm of the Living and the Underworld. In it’s whole, the Astral Plane resembles the world of the living and takes the form of the last place of those that are within. A common place that everyone sees is a place known as Fortress of Rest, here lies hundreds of cities that acts as a gathering place for the dead.

name: Realm of the Living
description:
Race: Everyone that is alive

One of the 14 Realms. One of the three largest realms in existence aside Heaven and Hell. It is also the most populated with near infinite lifeforms. During the birth of the Primordial Universe, the first universe, a powerful burst of energy split the universe into an endless string of other universes. Some universes can exist so close to one another that they can be travelled to from one another through portals known as gates. Others are far away with their own near parallel universes causing their own multiverse.

name: Eliteverse
description: The main universe found within the Eliteverse, it is Universe 7.

name: Universe 10
description: The universe where humans are dominate on Earth and considered our existing universe. It was one of the few universes to survive the Akuma destruction.

name: Mirror Universe
description: A complex yet fragile place that mirrors each individual universe. It was artificially created by the Mirror Master and inhabits the Porcelain People and House of Dolls. It can be accessed through any mirrored surface.

name: Miniverse
description: A universe where everyone and everything is miniaturized. It is home to the stories of Mini Heroes, Mini Villains, and Mini Warriors.

name: Dead Universe
description: Shortly after the Big Bang event happen, this universe continued a similar evolutionary path as our own until a disease swept through its many worlds turning its citizens into zombies. Only a few million are immune. It is featured in the Rise of the Dead Saga as two descendants attempt to control the dead with a powerful item called the Pearl of Indomnia.

name: Universe 818
description: This universe is like our own, except its technology is thousands of years more advanced and most people on Earth has have their minds uploaded to a virtual world.

name: Virtual World
description: A virtual reality universe. It can take the appearance of any game that is being played. It effectively exists within the Omniverse.

name: Omniverse
description: It is believed and greatly studied by even the gods. That every form of media from books, games, comics, someone’s mind, our reality, the multiverse, movies, tv shows, etc. all are real, and each exists in their own universe. All of this exists within a collective Omniverse and no one being except Anka and Elshack have ever been able to see it as a whole and understand it.

name: Universe 1986
description: The main universe for most printed media found within the Eliteverse. Unless otherwise stated, this universe serves as the primary universe for books, comics, novels, and other printed material.

name: The Dog Universe or Universe 444
description: A universe created by The Dog when it won a war against The Cat. This universe was destroyed by the Akuma.

name: The Cat Universe or Universe 999
description: A universe created by The Cat when she won a war against The Dog. This universe was destroyed by the Akuma.

name: Primordial Universe
description:
Also known as: Universe 1

Is the original universe and the first to have been created during the early years of the Omniverse. Here it is believed that every race on every planet that is inhabited is highly advanced. Their united war created the Omniverse.

name: Universe 318
description: A universe that is shown in the story, The Multiverse. It appears to have no sound.

name: Universe 899
description: A universe where most of Earth was flooded and everyone had to build their cities in the sky. It is believed to the be the universe of The Jetsons and the Flintstones.

name: Universe 1962
description: The universe that is believed to be the universe of Bewitched.

name: Universe 1965
description: The universe that is believed to be the universe of I Dream of Jeannie.

name: Universe 111
description: The universe which shows the Lazaron siblings never learning of each other and never save the world from the Horsemen of the Apocalypse. This universe was destroyed by the Akuma.

name: Universe 717
description: The universe where the Elite Force are villains and every hero in the main universe is a villain and the villains of the main universe are heroes. This universe is destroyed by the Akuma.

name: Universe 700
description: This universe was destroyed by the Akuma, it was seen to be a fairly normal place with no magic or superpowered individuals. However, its skies were always red because of its red sun.

name: Universe 600
description: In this universe it never evolved pass the ice age. It was destroyed by the Akuma.

name: Universe 515
description: Here the universe has purple void instead of black like the main universe. It was destroyed by the Akuma.

name: Universe 2010
description: With partnership with AMC, this universe was briefly seen to have been saved during the Akuma’s destruction. It is the universe of the Walking Dead.

name: Universe 1996
description: With partnership with Nintendo, this universe was visited when the Eliteverse, the Pokemon Universe, and the Digimon Universe crossover.

name: Universe 1997
description: With partnership with Bandai, this universe was visited when the Eliteverse, the Pokemon Universe, and the Digimon Universe crossover.

name: Universe 1993
description: With partnership with Hasbro, this universe was crossover when the Power Rangers from every generation and the Earth Raiders combined forces to save their respective Earths from destruction.

name: Shadow Realm
description:
Race: Shadow Creatures

One of the 14 Realms. A desolate place where shadows and shadow creatures live. It was created shortly after Tonik was defeated and banished by the other Domi Mages during the early days of magic. It has cities, homes, schools, and worlds like our own universe. It can be accessed through shadows of sacred places and powerful people. Its skies are always a shade of red and orange because of its dark red sun.

name: Dreomede
description:
Race: Dream Gods

Dreomede or often called the Dream Realm is one of the 14 Realms. It is a place often seen only in the dreams of a sleeping being. Ruled by Onarosh and his siblings, this realm is coated in beautiful lights, a peaceful aura, and surrounded by mountains. It is connected to the south by Nigerikarte and to the west by the Imaginarium.

name: Quanti’h
description:
Race: Varies, Akuma and its children

Quanti’h is one of the 14 realms and newly discovered. It is home to over a million worlds like those found in the Realm of the Living. On each of those worlds are dimensions that can connect to almost any moment in existence. This realm is often used by powerful beings and its citizens to travel between realms. This ability, however, is almost entirely forbidden and unknown to the rest of the realms. Its existence is unknown even to Olerta. While it was attempting to re-enter the Realm of the Living, the Akuma created this vast realm and filled it with human like beings of whose bodies appeared like the night sky. On seven of its worlds were the Akuma’s children.

name: Heaven
description:
Race: All races of Angels, Adam, Eve, GOD, Anka, the Gods, Primordial Ones, Yonrohs, Heavenly Beasts

One of the 14 realms. Consisting of the upper part of existence, nothing is said to exist above it except Anka (also known as the Primordial Chaos) of which no one can see accept some Primordial ones and the Ultimate One. Heaven is a massive place consisting of numerous levels each only accessed together through long bridges and or gates that are as tall as the sky on Earth. They each are guarded by a Celestial Guardian before the guardians were sent to Earth to guard it from the rise of demonic threats. Heaven consists of:

name: Vilon
description: The lowest level which is closest to Heaven. It is where Guardian Angels, The Watchers, Primordial Ones, and the Garden of Eden exists. It is ruled by Gabriel.

name: Araphel
description: The level above Vilon. It is the place resembling a massive city made of silver and gold. It is engulfed by a long golden river. It is home to all those that die and are sent to live out the rest of their time, in Heaven.

name: Raqia
description: The third level that is ruled by two angels, Zachariel and Raphael. Because of its massive size it is home to many things including the Elements of Existence (Fire, Rock, Water, Energy, Death, Life, Mass, Matter, and Time), Andvom (the home of all Time, Shecknurd, and the Arcota), and is home to the largest prison of mystical beings called Oblivion.

name: Shehaqim
description: Ruled by Anahel, it is the place where the idea of nature was born. It is home to where magic was created and from where it flows.

name: Maon
description: It houses the Altar, the Temple, and the heavenly Jerusalem. It is ruled by Michael.

name: Makon
description: Ruled by Samael, is houses the Ishim and Song-Uttering Choirs

name: Zebul
description: The seventh level that is ruled by Sachiel. It is the birthplace of all things in creation including newborn souls, Eternity, home of the GODs, lies here including Primordial beasts including the High Council.

name: Araboth
description: Houses the Throne of GOD where GOD dwells, the arch angels, Seraphim, the Cherubim, Hayyoth, and where all creation is made.

name: Kendole
description: The ninth level is home to Anka (the primordial chaos) and nothing exists here and is said to be a secret even to GOD. Azazel has visited this place twice, once to deliver to old GOD to become a part of Anka again and at the end of time to deliver the current GOD to become a part of Anka again.

name: Hell
description:
Race: Santaniel, Belckus, demons, demonic entities, Hell creatures

One of the 14 realms. Containing the lowest parts of existence. Above it lies the underworld and from it exists all aspects of the place for torment and punishment of the worse of things of that person’s life. It consists of several levels each worse than the previous. At its lowest level is the King of all evil, Belckus and his eldest son Santaniel is imprisoned above him.

name: Onur
description: Often called the underworld in the Elitshian Mythology. It is a place of perpectual sadness and regret. It is the home of the underworld gods and place where the dead is punished for their crimes and sins while on Earth.

name: Sheol
description: Is home to demons and the place where many demonic entities live and roam. There is a small cave that is located on the far south of this area covered in holy water, that leads to the land of the living. The most powerful or semi powerful demons passes through here to go to the land of the living.

name: Abaddon
description: Home of the rulers of Hell in the absence of Santaniel and Belckus. This level has large castles scattered about and houses hundreds of demons a piece. It is also the home to the Knights of Hell.

name: Be’er Shachat
description: Is the pit of corruption, the place where magical entities including Gods, magical beings, etc go to be punished.

name: Tit ha-Yaven
description: Is the clinging mud pit, here the souls of the damned flows into Onur. The worse of punishments are taken here for both humans and higher beings alike.

name: Sha’are Mavet
description: The Gates to Hell is located underneath the 66 seals scattered across Earth. If all are broken, then Gehenna is opened and Belckus is awaken.

name: Tzalmavet
description: Home to Santaniel, the youngest Archangel and son of GOD. Like his ancestor Belckus, he was punished for his way of thinking and war against GOD, for this he was thrown to Hell where he fell into a slumber. A palace was built around him and so was a tomb to restore his powers before awakening. If half of the 66 seals are broken then he can awaken, bringing forth the Apocalypse.

name: Gehenna
description: Like his uncle Chaos, Belckus was thrown to the lowest part of existence before Hell existed. He was put into a slumber and 66 gates were placed around him and the place called Gehenna or the Valley of Purgatory was built to house Belckus and the Belki’ remains. Here the souls of those that follows him, and the Hellish creatures resides.

name: Onur
location: Above Hell, below the rest of the existence
description:
Also known as: Underworld
Race: the dead

One of the 14 realms. Most noticeable as the Underworld, the name Onur means “dead” to the Elitshians. Here lies many regions mentioned throughout this book and from its core lies the kingdom of Montum.

name: Norgard
description:
Also known as: Eternity
Race: spirits of the dead

One of the 14 realms. Also called Eternity. Either it’s a place like Earth or it’s a place like Heaven, Eternity is only seen to the dead and is almost impossible to get to unless the person is dead or dying. Here they are visited by several spirits associated with the afterlife, some of the most well-known are the Angels of Death. The Grim Reaper of Middle Eastern Mythology stands guard. Its exact location is a secret and standing guard in its center is a mysterious girl who holds the secret of all existence. Chain by the hands, her mouth, ears, eyes, and feet, this mysterious girl shall not speak of the secret of existence, or all could be destroyed. Her birth is unknown and why she was chosen remains a secret even today.

name: Eden
description:
Race: GOD, The Neither, Chaos (in the beginning)

Eden surrounds the entirety of existence and is the birthplace of Chaos, GOD, The Neither. When they were born, Eden appeared around them. Regardless of their power and curiosity, the three celestials were unable to leave Eden as it was considered endless. All of existence known to us, exists within only a small fraction of Eden’s true size.

name: Ein
description:
Race: Elshack

One of the 14 realms, Ein is a still place where only Elshack and large shards of glass and light is known to exists. Elshack created this place while creating the Celestial Trio and the Misukune Egg. Only Elshack and The Neither can enter this domain. It located on the opposite side of all of existence in Eden.

name: Universe 666
description:
Race: Varies

Similar in almost all ways to our own universe, Universe 666 is populated with serial killers, murderers, and is absent of cape wearing heroes that we have grown accustomed to in our own universe. Magic is also almost extinct with only a few capable of using it and the High Council has since been defeated by the rise of the Overlords. In this Universe, the seal here broke, causing demons to flow endlessly into innocent humans and creatures. This universe is also home to Eliteverse Dark, an assortment of brutally and adult rated stories and characters.

name: Dimensional Plane
description:
Race: numerous

Dimensional Planes while not as vast as a Realm, they can contain an infinite reality within them. Currently there are only 5 known dimensional planes.

name: Dimensional Plane 1
description: The Nano Dimensional Plane, a microscopic place that exists in the smallest of places where entire realities exist appearing like our own albeit more technically advance and magical.

name: Dimensional Plane 2
description: Tempi Domerum, a place that Shecknurd created during the earliest creation of Time. Time here moves backwards starting from the most advance of technology to prehistoric times.

name: Dimensional Plane 3
description: 3rd dimension is the main Eliteverse.

name: Dimensional Plane 4
description: Only one reality exists including the Primordial Universe.

name: Dimensional Plane 5
description: Home of the Djiins and Imps where magic is so strong that it allows its numerous realities and residents to possess massive number of magical abilities.
